text: oh also, i have noticed that uh codex still always uses the oracle but claude doesnt. and to be honest the oracle diverts codex a lot because it still at large points at hmsc-int when everything that we are going forward with is now specific to @cart/editor/ so there is something we can do about that, either silence the oracle codex searches or enforce it for both but tidy it up, which the 2nd option i think is better, since claude gets by quite well without it
